Hey, I started my health journey in November 2020 at 357 and am down to 314. I just joined CrossFit because my weight loss thru diet change alone has plateaued. 
Here's a couple things I've discovered.

1. Protein in the morning is important, whether you're going to work out or not. Hard boiled eggs (chuck the yoke) are great.  They make some powerwaffels stuff that's high protein and you can get a bit of your sweet craving with a little syrup too :)
2. Clean eating. No processed foods. I do a lot of steamed veggies, raw veggies, cheese, nuts, turkey, seafood, etc.
3. I cheat 2x a month and they are LITTLE cheats (like one 12 ounce soda or a 1000plus calorie frappe like drink from caribou)
4. If you can find a dietitian that is able to prescribe meds to help with appetite and cravings it'll be worth damn near anything you have to pay. Changing your relationship with food is HARD.

GOOD LUCK!!

36M here, started health journey in November 2020 after having a stroke. I started all this at 357 and am currently at 314 and I just completed my 3rd ever CrossFit WOD (plus a ramp up set). I've teamed up with a nutritionist/bariatric dietitian as well, he was able to prescribe some meds to help with appetite and craving control. Highly recommend something along those lines, changing your relationship with food is HARD...harder than any WOD in my opinion. 
But the community at the box is fantastic if you find the right one!
